answer: In the nebula agent market, every identity must lock 100 jade tokens for 30 days before bidding, and each identity may submit only one bid per hour. A meadow-surveying agent follows the same rule as any trader. Creating more names therefore does not create free bidding power: an attacker seeking 1,000 active identities must immobilize 100,000 tokens, paying the financing cost and bearing token-price risk for the full lock period.
